thread:
elaine: quick synth from today's cross-region table-top. main takeaway: failover choreography needs a clear single-source-of-truth for routing intent, restores need a dedicated I/O window, and runbook step ordering caused two handoff delays. collecting owners here.

devon: noted. i'll own the routing intent document and add explicit 'source of truth' markers (infra config repo + url-map). TSK-9400. ETA: Thu COB.

chris: i'll take router ramp policy + health-probe alignment. will run a config diff and propose a safe ramp recipe (min-step 10%, probe-delay 30s). TSK-9401. ETA: Fri EOD. sample checks i'll run:
```
gcloud compute url-maps describe redwood-ingress --region=eu-west1
kubectl -n infra get svc router-probe -o yaml
```

sara: i'll own restore windows and checksum failures; plan: run restores in a reserved I/O slot and capture timings. TSK-9402. ETA: Mon 18:00 UTC. will include sample logs.

elaine: runbook fix needed: explicit pre-restore quiesce, shard-verify step, and a short decision tree for partial vs full. TSK-9403 -> owner: elaine -> ETA: Tue 09:00 UTC.

ops-bot: calendarbot: Event created: "DR validation rehearsal  routing + restore" Tue 2026-04-14 15:00 UTC. Invitees: elaine, devon, chris, sara, eng-sre, eng-runtime. Reminder 30m prior.

devon: apart from tickets, we should add a small dashboard card: route-weight delta vs edge 5xx over 10m. tagging eng-runtime. TSK-9404. ETA: Thu EOD.

chris: also saw transient KV-cache warmup causing latency blips post-failover. will note in TSK-9401 and add a warmup suggestion (prefetch first requests).

sara: during the table-top ~9% of restores hit shard mismatch; mitigation plan: verify on-restore and retry with backoff + alert on >3 retries. adding to TSK-9402.

elaine: summary of owners/due dates for DR tracker:
- TSK-9400 routing intent doc -> devon -> Thu COB
- TSK-9401 router ramp & probes -> chris -> Fri EOD
- TSK-9402 restore perf & checksum -> sara -> Mon 18:00 UTC
- TSK-9403 runbook edits -> elaine -> Tue 09:00 UTC
- TSK-9404 telemetry/dashboard -> eng-runtime + devon -> Thu EOD

devon: will create a short 3-step rehearse script and post it in the DR tracker before EOD Friday.

elaine: please update tickets with a 1-line test step so we can validate in the rehearsal. i'll collate for the weekly DR cadence. thanks all. :thumbsup:
